intro: Infiltrating the Cult is a quest in Shen'dar Village where an unfamiliar adventurer is tasked with approaching a local missionary named Sania Silverstream. Beneath her benign religious exterior, Sania recruits followers for the Al'Aketh, a cult dedicated to the Windlord Al'Akir. The mission seeks to uncover the cult's true designs for the settlement before an uneasy peace shatters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.
You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?
There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.
